messages:
Alex Chen: uploaded a quick mock — compact rows for API tokens, each row can expand to show scopes, last-used, and rotation actions. link: https://imgur.com/mock1
Maya Patel: love the compactness. question: when collapsed, how do we show scopes without making it noisy?
Samir Gupta: show first scope as a pill + "+2" style overflow. hover shows full list. keeps rows tidy.
Priya R: Agree. Also prefer 'Last used • 3d ago' under the pill in smaller gray text for scanability.
Vik (UI): mock tweak: put the expand affordance on the right and make it keyboard focusable with aria-expanded. code: `button[aria-expanded]`
Alex Chen: +1. can we also inline the rotate/revoke icons so power users don't need to expand? maybe low-contrast icons to avoid visual clutter.
Maya Patel: caution: inline revoke might be dangerous — need confirmation modal or undo. suggestion: show rotate inline, revoke only in expanded or behind more menu.
Samir Gupta: could show a reversible toast: "API token revoked — Undo" for 6s. no modal unless destructive confirmed.
Priya R: Copy nit: "API token" vs "API key" — we use "credentials" elsewhere. marketing uses "token"; product uses "key" in older screens. we should standardize.
Vik (UI): propose we standardize on "API token" in UI, update empty states and tooltips. Also update alt text for secret reveal: `aria-label=\"Reveal API token\"`.
Alex Chen: good call. Ops-bot: reminder — update docs if we change wording.
ops-bot: (automated) s/keys/tokens/ PR needed in docs repo: https://git.company/doc-requests/123
Maya Patel: accessibility check: when expanded panel opens, focus should move to first actionable (copy button) and pressing Esc collapses. also ensure screen reader announces expanded content.
Samir Gupta: for collapsed view, keyboard row-level actions: left/right to move, Enter to expand. we have similar behavior in credentials list elsewhere, mimic that.
Priya R: empty state proposal: tile with brief line "Create an API token to authenticate with Redwood services" + primary CTA "Create token" and secondary link "Learn about scopes". small accessibility hint: don't rely on color in the tile.
Vik (UI): copy tweak for undo toast: "Token revoked — Undo" (6s) and success toast after 6s "Token permanently removed". keep tone neutral.
Alex Chen: next steps: Vik to update mock with scope pill overflow + inline rotate + revoke behind more menu, Maya to write accessibility acceptance criteria, Samir to spec keyboard interactions, Priya to run copy pass and send standardized glossary term. I'll open a tiny RFC and a design PR.
Maya Patel: ack, I'll add keyboard examples and aria attributes in the acceptance criteria doc.
Samir Gupta: will add keybindings and a11y test cases to the eng tasks.
Priya R: I'll sync with content team about token/credential terminology and update the docs PR.
Vik (UI): will push updated Figma frame by EOD and link here.
Alex Chen: thanks all — tagging @Maya and @Vik for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
